title: Food Spoilage Allowance — Homeowner Service Contracts Refrigerator Cash Settlements
content:
**Allowance.** On a customer-elected cash settlement for a refrigerator under a Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contract, a food spoilage allowance applies by the calendar days from the request date to today:

- **150.00** when the refrigerator has been out of service more than 7 days;
- **75.00** when it has been out of service more than one day but no more than 7 days;
- **nothing** for a refrigerator out of service one day or less, or for any other item.

The allowance is added to the cash starting figure before that figure is compared with the remaining item and aggregate benefits.

| Days from the request date to today | Refrigerator | Any other item |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | nothing | nothing |
| 2 | 75.00 | nothing |
| 7 | 75.00 | nothing |
| 8 | 150.00 | nothing |

**Reading the record.** The request date is the date the service request for the refrigerator was placed; the count runs to today.
